items.title: Outback 9間將關閉分店列表
items.summary: Threads user @kong.news posted a detailed list of 9 Outback Steakhouse branches that closed: JP Plaza (CWB), Fenwick Street (Wan Chai), Telford Plaza II (Kowloon Bay), TST Centre, Silvercord (TST), Deli Place (Whampoa), D·PARK (Tsuen Wan), The Lohas (TKO), Tuen Mun Town Plaza. Reply to a now-unavailable post. Documents the historical closures.
